preconditions.description: The number of points n is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i, b_i, c_i, d_i in points)
all(1 <= b_i <= 10**9 for a_i, b_i, c_i, d_i in points)
all(1 <= c_i <= 10**9 for a_i, b_i, c_i, d_i in points)
all(1 <= d_i <= 10**9 for a_i, b_i, c_i, d_i in points)

postconditions.description: The number of moves c is between 1 and half the number of points.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n for a, b in moves)
postconditions.description: Each point a in a move is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= b <= n for a, b in moves)
postconditions.description: Each point b in a move is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(a != b for a, b in moves)
postconditions.description: Points a and b in a move are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all((x_a + 1, y_a) or (x_a, y_a + 1) for x_a, y_a in new_positions_a)
postconditions.description: Point a is moved to either (x_a + 1, y_a) or (x_a, y_a + 1).

postconditions.expression: all((x_b + 1, y_b) or (x_b, y_b + 1) for x_b, y_b in new_positions_b)
postconditions.description: Point b is moved to either (x_b + 1, y_b) or (x_b, y_b + 1).
There exists a line passing through the origin and the new coordinates of points a and b for each move.
